summary: Envoy Medical, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the termination of its At The Market Offering Agreement (ATM Agreement) dated January 17, 2025, effective June 24, 2026. The ATM facility authorized up to $15 million in common stock sales. The termination was announced via press release, reflecting management's confidence in the company's capital position. No price, premium, or advisor details are provided. This is a voluntary termination of an equity facility, not tied to a broader special situation. Watch for future financing needs or capital market activity as the company relies on existing cash.
